item.title: Article: Someone Who Inspires Me
item.prompt_text: A student magazine is asking readers: 'Who inspires you, and why?' Write an article about a person you know personally, for example a family member, a teacher or a neighbour.
item.target_grammar: past simple and past continuous for a short story; relative clauses (who, which)
item.target_structure: engaging opening + who the person is + a story about them + their qualities + what I learned

checklist.point: Introduce the person and how you know them
Tell a short story about something they did
Explain how they have influenced you
